title: The One-T File — Wrong Mountain, Right Stencil
subtitle: Mount Ebot (17 Aethel) and the Wariocopter audit (18 Aethel), 1032 BF
imageCaption: The stencil did more work than the summit plank.
hook: They climbed the wrong mountain because a compositor dropped a letter. The next morning they looted cargo that already had their name on it.

plainSummary.point: The cargo already had his name on it.
plainSummary.detail: Dobbs read PROPERTY OF WARIO WARE INC on a fitting and then on every crate. Wario named the remembering an audit.

plainSummary.point: Rift and Heartstone are speech, not survey.
plainSummary.detail: The charter pilot used both words after the lights went green. Neither is on the 17th briefing table.

background.why: Part I is the crash, the stencilled produce sack, and a summit plank reading Mount Ebot — one T. This leaf is the morning after, in the air.

brief: Keep the file open until Heartstone is an object on a table, not a word in a cockpit.

threads.title: The cargo was already his
threads.text: Wario declared an audit after Dobbs read PROPERTY OF WARIO WARE INC on the fitting and then on the room. The legal theory is the finding.

threads.title: Rift and Heartstone, spoken not surveyed
threads.text: On the 18th the charter pilot used dimensional rift and Heartstone. Neither is on the 17th briefing. Do not promote speech to survey.

leads.title: Put the Heartstone on a table
leads.objective: Establish whether Heartstone is a mapped object, a Wario story, or a pilot's price.
leads.why: The word enters the file only after the lights go green. If it is real, the One-T error is a preface. If it is not, the expedition is still a misprint with extra altitude.

exhibits.title: The stencil that ended the loot speech
exhibits.onRecord: Dobbs turned a brass fitting to the bulb and read [[roll:3|PROPERTY OF WARIO WARE INC|the stencil is load-out paint, not a kingdom seizure mark. Wario packed his own hold.|stencils get copied. A cousin spelling is not a confession.]]. He then looked at the room. The room agreed.
exhibits.analysis:
## The confession is the font

Waluigi does not need a theory of theft. He has a stencil. [[roll:4|Wario's panic is the second exhibit|he froze when Dobbs asked who packed the crates. Aerodynamics is what a man says when the label is already dry.|panic reads as theatre. Wario panics for sport.]]. The audit is what he named the remembering.

## Do not call it a heist

Waluigi called it a heist with better stationery in the air. On paper it is worse: you cannot steal what you already shipped. The file stays on the stencil, not on the joke.

exhibits.title: The card the pilot did not see
exhibits.secured: 18 Aethel, 1032 BF · luxury seating, then cockpit pocket
exhibits.onRecord: Consideration was the silver canister. The card admits [[roll:3|one checkpoint on landing|the issuer is still the man flying. If he is not, the card is paper.|VIP cards are printed for people who already had the door.]]. In the cockpit the pilot pretended not to see it.
exhibits.analysis:
## Blind spots for a tin

The charter pilot from Part I is selling manifests now. Waluigi files the card as proof of the trade, not of landing privileges. [[roll:5|He looked away in the cockpit because the card is extra-legal|a man who issues a favor cannot also log it.|he looked away because he was flying.]]. Heartstone and rift remain speech.
